purpose: Teach: コンビネーション/クズ/適格/供与/にあたり/勲章/公聴/意匠

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、製品の色のコンビネーションを工夫しろ
lines.en: Refine the color combinations in our product line.
lines.style: Brisk, authoritative. Sharp attack on the opening verb. Measured pace. Spine-straight posture in the voice — a directive, not a suggestion. No warmth, no apology.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。クズ材、つまりクズ素材も再利用します
lines.en: Yes. We'll incorporate scrap materials back into production.
lines.style: Steady, competent. Clean consonants. Even pace. Demonstrates he's thought this through — matter-of-fact confidence without self-promotion. Brief and professional.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、適格な人材の採用を強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen our hiring criteria for qualified personnel.
lines.style: Sharp, direct. Clipped opening on the verb. Deliberate pacing. The tone of someone accustomed to being heard — no need to repeat or elaborate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品のサンプル供与を取引先に進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll begin distributing product samples to our partners.
lines.style: Efficient, responsive. Slight lean forward in the voice — showing action already underway. Clean articulation. No hesitation, just progress reported.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、契約締結にあたり、慎重に進めろ
lines.en: When finalizing contracts, proceed with caution.
lines.style: Deliberate, weighting each word. Pause after the comma. Quiet but firm — not rushing toward signatures. The voice of experience guarding against carelessness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。功労社員に勲章授与の社内式典を準備します
lines.en: Yes. I'm preparing the internal ceremony for presenting honors to our long-service employees.
lines.style: Formal, structured. Precise articulation. Steady rhythm — conveying the solemnity of the occasion while staying practical. Respectful but not stiff.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新条例の公聴会に参加しろ
lines.en: Attend the public hearing on the new municipal ordinance.
lines.style: Crisp, action-oriented. Snap on the opening word. No padding. The voice of someone used to delegation — expect compliance, not pushback.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。意匠、つまり意匠登録の手続きを進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll advance the design registration procedures.
lines.style: Concise, final. Tight, efficient delivery. Slight closure in the tone — wrapping up the list. Professional endpoint, not rushed.
